title: Social Media & Influencer Analyst
description:
Job Title

Social Media & Influencer Analyst

Location

Asda House

Employment Type

Full time

Contract Type

Permanent

Hours Per Week

37.5

Salary

Competitive salary plus benefits.

Category

Promotions and Advertising

Closing Date

29 November 2026

Find your Everything


A vital role within the busy social media team, working across Asda and George, helping to inform and evaluate our social & influencer strategy, expand our audience, and generate actionable insights.?

As an expert in this area, you'll be leading on collating briefs, building dashboards & Boolean search strings, to provide powerful insights to the business. As well as ensuring we are in-line with best practice for social analytics & social listening.

This role will require high levels of both analytic and strategic thinking, embedding a data-driven culture through knowledge-sharing and collaboration.?

You'll be a natural storyteller with a strong ability to bring complex data to life – supporting the team to grow in a competitive environment.?

You will:?

  • Become a key contact for all social analytics queries.
  • Analyse user engagement by researching the way customers interact with our social media platforms and help us predict future behaviour and trends?
  • Keep abreast of competitor focuses and performance, making recommendation to leverage strategy and creative formats and trends to help us stay ahead of the curve?
  • In partnership with the media, strategy and creative teams, establish hypotheses to test key metrics to inform decisions, measure media success, and audience performance?
  • Scope, prioritize, execute tests (or work with measurement partners), and interpret test results. Aggregate learnings for distribution across social teams (reactive & planned)?
  • Build and maintain dashboards to visualize data based on technical specifications, business goals, and KPIs to enable faster insights, recommendations, and tailor reporting to meet ongoing needs.?
  • Work closely with our Community Managers & Social Media Team to provide insights into trending topics.?

Lets Find out about you

  • Extensive expertise in deep social listening, analysis and reporting within large, fast paced business environment. Retail setting preferred (FMCG)?
  • Proven experience using one or more of the following social insight tools: Sprinklr, Brandwatch, CreatorIQ and native platform analytics.?
  • Proven ability to write and present in-depth reports, providing data visualisation and insights within tight deadlines to senior stakeholders.?
  • Strong experience of stakeholder engagement, training and knowledge sharing across teams/functions.?
  • Experience in spotting social trends and trending conversations highlighting opportunities for the team to tap into the conversation.??
  • Ability to monitor organic performance and highlight amplification opportunities through organic boosting. Whilst working with external agencies to amplify the post.??
  • Experience managing and optimising social media budgets is desirable.?

Everything you'll love

To ensure we balance moments where we know we need to collaborate together and the need for flexibility, Asda has a hybrid way of working with a minimum 3 days a week in one of our Home Offices. Over and above this, each area of Asda may have additional requirements which may require spending more days in the office, visiting suppliers, stores or depots.

You will also get an excellent benefits package including:

  • Discretionary company bonus

  • Company pension up to 7% matched

  • 15% colleague discount in store and online

  • Free access to wellbeing services such as Stream, 24/7 virtual GP, counselling, health and dental cash plans and a 24/7 employee assistance helpline, alongside discounts across a range of services and activities, from airport parking, enhanced to theme parks and cinemas.

  • Asda Allies Inclusion Networks – helping colleagues to make sure everybody is included and that our differences are recognised and celebrated

  • Excellent parental leave policies, including maternity & adoption leave, paternity leave, shared parental leave, neonatal care leave, and support for those doing fertility treatments.

We want all colleagues to be able to bring their best and true selves to work, every day. Simply put, we want our colleagues to be Proud to be Asda and proud to be themselves
